tropical_outlook: NHC Tropical Weather Outlook issued 8:00 AM EDT Tue Oct 20, 2026: no active tropical cyclones in the Atlantic basin and nothing flagged in the Gulf of Mexico. The only system of note is a non-tropical nor'easter/coastal low meandering offshore of the Mid-Atlantic this week (NHC had earlier assigned it ~40% odds of subtropical transition per a Weatherboy report of unconfirmed date). Local offices (CBS Baltimore, Fox45, ABC7 NY, NWS OKX) expect it to stay well offshore, producing only breezy afternoons, minor bay/coastal flooding Tue-Thu and rip currents, then pulling away by the weekend with a fresh shot of chilly, dry air. No tropical threat to Charlotte, Baltimore, Houston or the Gulf coast for Oct 22-26. Sources: https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/cyclones/ ; https://www.cbsnews.com/baltimore/news/noreaster-offshore-keeps-maryland-crisp-cool-and-comfortable/ ; https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=OKX&issuedby=OKX&product=AFD

2026_07_NE_CHI.conditions: Clear and cool evening; light NE/lake breeze, no rain
2026_07_NE_CHI.notes: NWS Chicago point forecast updated morning of Oct 20: Thursday sunny, high 67, calm wind becoming NE ~5 mph in the afternoon; Thursday night low ~52. Kickoff 8:15pm ET (7:15pm CT) so temps should be falling through the upper 50s. Lakefront NE flow may push 8-12 mph with light gusts at the stadium but no significant wind issue. One aggregator (aqi.in) shows showers/12C, discarded as inconsistent with NWS. Two days out, so confidence is decent.

2026_07_PIT_NO.conditions: Cool, mostly dry afternoon; chance of light morning rain clearing before kickoff
2026_07_PIT_NO.notes: Schedule file lists this as dome/closed, but Stade de France is an open-air stadium (fixed canopy covers the stands only; the pitch is exposed), so weather applies. Sortiraparis forecast published Oct 19: Sunday Oct 25 looks dry with a chilly morning (~4C) and afternoon high ~13C (55F). Weather Underground 10-day shows 'AM light rain', high ~60F/low 48F. Kickoff 3:30pm CEST = peak afternoon temp. Wind value is climatological (no explicit forecast found). Searched for Steelers-Saints game coverage but none surfaced; forecast is city-level.

2026_07_SF_ATL.conditions: Sunny and pleasant; roof likely closed regardless
2026_07_SF_ATL.notes: NWS Atlanta point forecast (updated Oct 19): Sunday Oct 25 high near 71, low ~47, mostly clear. WXIA 11Alive 70/50, 0% precip; Weather Underground 71/45 sunny. Kickoff 1pm ET ~ mid-60s outside. Falcons keep the roof closed for the vast majority of games even in ideal weather; treat as indoor conditions.

2026_07_CIN_BAL.conditions: Sunny, crisp and dry; light-to-moderate N/NE breeze as offshore nor'easter departs
2026_07_CIN_BAL.notes: CBS Baltimore (Oct 20) and Fox45 (Oct 19-20): nor'easter stays offshore; sunshine, crisp and comfortably cool through the weekend, breezy afternoons mainly Tue-Thu and along the beaches. Chilly air settles in as the storm pulls away; widespread frost possible Sat/Sun morning. AccuWeather Sunday 64/46 plenty of sunshine 4% rain. Kickoff 1pm ET ~ upper 50s to low 60s. Gusts to ~15-20 mph possible if the low lingers closer than expected; low (not zero) wind risk. No NWS day-7 point value found.

2026_07_TB_CAR.conditions: Dry and sunny, cool morning warming to ~70; light north wind
2026_07_TB_CAR.notes: WCCB (Oct 20): dry and sunny both weekend days, Saturday mid-60s, Sunday near 70. NWS Charlotte point forecast (updated Oct 19): Sat ~65, Sun ~70. Hoodline Oct 20: Saturday NE winds 9-14 mph, overnight low mid-40s; no meaningful rain through the period. WCNC earlier showed Sunday 70/45, 0% precip, N 6 mph. Kickoff 1pm ET ~ low-to-mid 60s. Fire-weather dryness is the only regional concern.

2026_07_NYG_HOU.conditions: Warm and humid, partly to mostly cloudy, rain unlikely; roof expected closed
2026_07_NYG_HOU.notes: KHOU 10-day: Sunday 85/62, 0% rain. FOX 26: H 83 / L 64. Weather Underground: 83/62 mostly cloudy. Kickoff noon CT ~ upper 70s. Texans keep NRG's roof closed for nearly all games (open only for a handful of cool, dry days); with highs in the low-to-mid 80s and humidity, closed is the expectation. No NWS Houston/Galveston day-6 value found.

2026_07_MIA_NYJ.conditions: Sunny, dry and seasonably cool; N/NW breeze with chilly air behind the departing coastal low
2026_07_MIA_NYJ.notes: Fox 5 NY 7-day (Oct 20): Sunday high 61, low 41; weekend dry and seasonably cool, Saturday ~60. ABC7/NWS OKX (Oct 19-20): nor'easter meanders offshore through midweek with breezy NE winds and minor coastal flooding Wed, then drier/cooler air; considerable spread on the low's track noted by NWS OKX. Kickoff 1pm ET ~ mid-50s. Breezy conditions are plausible (10-15 mph, gusts ~20) if the low is slow to exit; this is the game to recheck Friday for wind. Notably cooler than Miami's norm.

2026_07_CLE_TEN.conditions: Sunny, dry and warm for late October; calm
2026_07_CLE_TEN.notes: WSMV First Alert (Oct 20): dry and sunny through the weekend, Saturday ~80, Sunday back in the 70s, lows near 50. Hoodline Oct 20: Sat 77 / Sun 76, no rain. NewsChannel 5 (Oct 20): no rain chances in the next 10 days; worsening drought. CPC 8-14 day favors above-normal temps and below-normal precip Oct 25-31. Kickoff noon CT ~ low 70s.

2026_07_DEN_ARI.conditions: Sunny, warm and dry; roof decision borderline (low 80s)
2026_07_DEN_ARI.notes: Weather Underground Glendale AZ: Sunday 82/63, sunny, 0.00 in. Fox 10 Phoenix earlier showed 81/63. Kickoff 1:05pm MST (4:05pm ET) in full afternoon sun, ~79-82F. Cardinals generally open the roof only when afternoon temps are comfortably below ~80 and open it more often as the season goes on; at 82 with direct sun this is a coin flip leaning closed. Either way no wind/precip impact. No NWS Phoenix day-6 point value found.

2026_07_KC_SEA.conditions: Cool and mostly cloudy; showers possible Sat night into Sunday morning, likely tapering by evening kickoff but models split
2026_07_KC_SEA.notes: FOX 13 Seattle (Oct 20): models disagree on a weekend front; some bring it through, others keep it offshore. Current call: chance of rain Saturday, best odds Saturday night into Sunday morning; weekend highs mid-to-upper 50s, lows mid-30s to low 40s. KIRO 7 (Oct 20): ridge rebuilds for drier weather Friday through Monday. Hoodline Oct 18: Sunday sunny ~58, no rain. Kickoff 5:20pm PT ~ low 50s, falling into the upper 40s. Wet-field residual risk if the front comes through; wind not expected to be a factor (S/SW 5-12). Recheck Friday.

2026_07_DAL_PHI.notes: Six days out; no day-7 NWS value found. CBS Philadelphia (Oct 19): sunny skies all week, Sunday Oct 25 high 67 / low 38; main concern is Wed-evening coastal flooding from the offshore nor'easter. AccuWeather 10-day (older snapshot) shows Monday Oct 26 sunny, 12% precip, next rain late Wed Oct 28. Kickoff 8:15pm ET implies temps in the low-to-mid 50s dropping toward the upper 40s by the 4th quarter. Pattern favors dry, cool and calm; recheck Saturday.
